processing: Selected US/Canada admin1 and North America admin0 map units; removed unused attributes; rounded coordinates to four decimals without line simplification; merged Antigua/Barbuda polygons into one AG click target.
limits: Generalized modern administrative navigation shapes, not Indigenous homelands, treaty boundaries or a statement about recognition/sovereignty.
Natural Earth defaults to de facto administrative boundary depiction; no legal boundary precision is claimed.
Small Caribbean islands need accessible list or enlarged click targets; outlines alone may be too small at a continent scale.
Alaska crosses the antimeridian; use dateline-aware projection or normalize its positive longitudes for a North America view.
Hawaii is included as a US state and may need an inset.
Political types and labels are copied from a Natural Earth snapshot rather than freshly adjudicated current legal status.
